title: Brand mark · Standard two line lock-up
slide_intent: Teach designers to protect a mark’s legibility when placing or reducing it. Its boundary and reproduction size affect how clearly people see the components.
strategic_value: Consistent clearance can preserve the relationship between the symbol, organization name and local name on crowded print pieces.
demonstration: Two annotated lockups sit inside cyan clearance frames. Dimension marks record the recommended minimum print height of one-third inch or 8 mm.
practical_value: Check the available space and intended reproduction method before choosing the size. Treat the printed minimum as a starting point for testing the substrate.
